summary: To add the gateway to an existing controller, switch the subscription channel to stable-2.6, keep auto_update false on the controller, and create an AnsibleAutomationPlatform naming the controller under spec.controller.name; the existing controller keeps its own Postgres pod.
questions: How do I deploy the platform gateway with an existing controller?
Where do I put the existing controller name in the AAP CR?
Does my existing controller keep its Postgres pod?
auto_update must be false for the existing controller

answer_card.title: Gateway with an existing controller
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Subscriptions: set channel to `stable-2.6`.
2. Keep `auto_update: false` on the existing controller.
3. Create instance:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatform
metadata:
  name: example-aap
  namespace: aap
spec:
  controller:
    disabled: false
    name: existing-controller-name
  eda:
    disabled: false
  hub:
    disabled: false
    storage_type: file
    file_storage_storage_class: <rwx-class>
    file_storage_size: 10Gi
```
The existing controller keeps its own Postgres pod.
